sparse_control.reproduction_python:
import json,platform,time,tracemalloc
from pathlib import Path
from storymodel import make_account
from storymodel.model import Context,Document,Entity,Participation,Span,State,Support,Unit
from storymodel.rich_account import upgrade_account,validate_rich_account
from storymodel.local_evidence import LocalEvidenceSpec,RecallSelection,derive_local_evidence

def account(side,count):
    document=Document.create(side,side,'AA PP BB\n'*count)
    root=Context(side=side,kind='narrated')
    supports=tuple(Support(document=document.id,spans=(Span(start=i*9,end=i*9+8),)) for i in range(count))
    entities=tuple(Entity.create(document.id,label,(supports[0],)) for label in ('AA','BB'))
    states=tuple(State(side=side,context=root.id,predicate='PP',evidence=(s,),
                      participants=tuple(Participation(entity=e.id,role=role,evidence=(s,)) for e,role in zip(entities,('agent','patient')))) for s in supports)
    units=tuple(Unit(kind='recall',support=s) for s in supports) if side=='recall' else ()
    base=upgrade_account(make_account((document,),contexts=(root,),entities=entities,units=units))
    return validate_rich_account(base.model_copy(update={'states':states}))
results=[]
recall=account('recall',20)
spec=LocalEvidenceSpec(units=tuple(RecallSelection(unit=u.id) for u in recall.units),max_candidates=4,max_postings=128)
for n in (100,1000):
    source=account('source',n)
    tracemalloc.start(); start=time.perf_counter()
    result=derive_local_evidence(source,recall,spec)
    seconds=time.perf_counter()-start
    _,peak=tracemalloc.get_traced_memory();tracemalloc.stop()
    assert all(r.postings_read<=128 and len(r.nominations)<=4 for r in result.retrieval)
    edges=sum(len(t.edges) for t in result.sequence.request.transitions)
    assert edges<=19*81
    results.append({'source_situations':n,'recall_units':20,'seconds':round(seconds,6),'peak_python_bytes':peak,'local_cells':len(result.cells),'transition_edges':edges,'retrieval_statuses':sorted({r.status for r in result.retrieval})})
value={'platform':platform.platform(),'python':platform.python_version(),'method':'One sample under tracemalloc around derive_local_evidence including account validation and transitions; no inference or Scala timing; inputs constructed beforehand; peak Python allocations, not RSS.','generator':'AA PP BB rows, each State predicate PP with same-label agent/patient local entity IDs; source no segments, recall20 units. max_candidates4/max_postings128; all repeated matches deliberately force search limits.','cases':results}
Path('data/local-evidence-size.json').write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(value))
